name: Ar 234 spectacle-type control yoke on its swing-aside column
view: the yoke from the pilot's seat: the two short horns of the spectacle yoke, the bomb release button on top of the right horn, the column curving down to the right where it pivots aside for the bomb sight
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the yoke's outline and the control layout reconstructed from the IL-2 Great Battles Ar 234 B-2 notes, the War Thunder description and public museum photos of the Ar 234 cockpit looked at for proportions; not traced from a photo.
